text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding anything that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans for emergencies. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can spot new dangers early and adjust your plans. Good risk management helps people and companies stay safe and successful.
